'''Togominda''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] situated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]]. It featured [[Salt/Legends|salt]] [[Geyser/Legends|geysers]], which attracted both [[free-trader]]s and [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to the world. [[Lynciro Corporation]] owned a private retreat on Togominda known as "[[Master of Coins]]."

==Description==
Togominda was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="GG" /> located in the [[Togominda system/Legends|Togominda system]], a part of the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]]. It was situated in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The world lay on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], which connected it to the [[Isde Naha system/Legends|Isde Naha system]] as well as the [[Berrol's Donn system/Legends|Berrol's Donn system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the neighboring [[Kriz sector/Legends|Kriz sector]].<ref name="OuterRim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Togominda was known for its [[Salt/Legends|salt]] [[Geyser/Legends|geysers]].<ref name="GG" />

==History==
After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] victory in a [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|war]] against the nearby civilization of the [[Mugaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="GG" /> at some point between approximately [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]],<ref name="MugaariDate">{{RepublicMugaariWarDate}}</ref> the former established the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the former [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]].<ref name="GG" /> Around [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]],<ref name="SectorDates" /> the portion of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] containing Togominda was re-designated as the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], and generations after that, the Anoat itself was further split into two parts, with Togominda becoming a part of the new Yarith sector.<ref name="GG" />

==Inhabitants==
Togominda served as the last stopover in the Greater Javin for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling further into the Outer Rim.<ref name="GG" /> The world's salt geysers attracted both [[free-trader]]s and daredevil [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Locations==
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] not long after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="Rough" /> of [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Planet Dreams, Incorporated]] had custom-developed the private retreat known as "[[Master of Coins]]" on Togominda for the [[Lynciro Corporation]], with the former company's primary [[Gender/Legends|saleswoman]] [[Treva Horme]] having negotiated the deal on it.<ref name="Rough" />

==Behind the scenes==
Togominda was introduced in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplements "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]"<ref name="GG" /> and "[[Rough and Tundra]]," both of which where published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[March 25]], [[2004]].<ref name="Rough" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed Togominda in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" />
